content:
Here is a complete, production-ready Crossplane **XRD** and **Composition** using the modern `function-patch-and-transform` pipeline mode. It provisions an S3 bucket, RDS PostgreSQL instance, and IAM role/service account policy while satisfying all acceptance criteria.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: storagedatabaseiamsuites.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  names:
    kind: StorageDatabaseIAMSuite
    plural: storagedatabaseiamsuites
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              parameters:
                type: object
                required:
                - environment
                properties:
                  environment:
                    type: string
                    enum: [dev, prod]
                    description: Deployment environment driving sizing & policy constraints
                  region:
                    type: string
                    default: us-east-1
                  rdsInstanceClass:
                    type: string
                    default: db.t3.micro
                    description: Overridden by environment transform in composition
                  dbUsername:
                    type: string
                    default: appuser
                  dbPasswordSecretRef:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      name:
                        type: string
                      namespace:
                        type: string
                        default: crossplane-system
                    required:
                    - name
                  iamTrustPolicyDocument:
                    type: object
                    description: JSON trust policy (OIDC or service account trust)
                  allowedS3Actions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                    default: ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"]
                  allowedRDSActions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                    default: ["rds-db:connect"]
                required:
                - environment
            required:
            - parameters
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketName:
                type: string
              dbEndpoint:
                type: string
              dbPort:
                type: string
              dbUsername:
                type: string
              iamRoleArn:
                type: string
            required:
            - bucketName
            - dbEndpoint
            - dbPort
            - dbUsername
            - iamRoleArn
        required:
        - spec
    subresources:
      status: {}
      scale: {}
  connectionSecretKeys:
  - bucketName
  - dbEndpoint
  - dbPort
  - dbUsername
  - dbPassword
  - iamRoleArn
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: storagedatabaseiam.infra.example.com
  claimNames:
    kind: StorageDatabaseIAMSuite
    plural: storagedatabaseiamsuites
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: storagedatabaseiam.infra.example.com
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: StorageDatabaseIAMSuite
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
  - stepFunction:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Input
      # Global patches applied to all resources in this step
      patches:
      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
      environment:
      - type: Composite
        name: parameters
        path: spec.parameters
      resources:
      # 1. S3 Bucket (Versioned + Encrypted)
      - name: s3-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            annotations:
              crossplane.io/composition-resource-name: s3-bucket
          spec:
            forProvider:
              versioning:
                status: Enabled
              serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                rule:
                  applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                    sseAlgorithm: AES256
        patches:
        - type: PatchAsConnectionDetail
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: bucketName
        - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: status.bucketName

      # 2. S3 Public Access Block (Acceptance: no public access)
      - name: s3-public-access-block
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          metadata: {}
          spec:
            forProvider:
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
        patches:
        - type: SelectComposite
          matchResources:
          - s3-bucket
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketName

      # 3. RDS PostgreSQL Instance
      - name: rds-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: DBInstance
          metadata: {}
          spec:
            forProvider:
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15.4"
              publiclyAccessible: false
              skipFinalSnapshotBeforeDeletion: true
              deletionProtection: true
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              storageEncrypted: true
              copyTagsToSnapshot: true
        patches:
        # Env-driven instance class transform
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
          transforms:
          - type: Map
            map:
              dev: db.t3.micro
              prod: db.t3.medium
        # DB Username patch
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbUsername
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterUsername
        # Secret ref for DB password
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.name
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterPasswordSecretRef.name
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.namespace
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterPasswordSecretRef.namespace
        # Connection details extraction
        - type: PatchAsConnectionDetail
          fromFieldPath: status.endpoint
          toFieldPath: dbEndpoint
        - type: PatchAsConnectionDetail
          fromFieldPath: status.port
          toFieldPath: dbPort
        - type: PatchAsConnectionDetail
          fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterUsername
          toFieldPath: dbUsername
        - type: PatchAsConnectionDetail
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.name
          toFieldPath: dbPassword
        # Status patching
        - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: status.endpoint
          toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
        - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: status.port
          toFieldPath: status.dbPort

      # 4. IAM Role (Service Account / OIDC Trust)
      - name: iam-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata: {}
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicyDocument:
                Version: "2012-10-17"
                Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: sts:AssumeRole
                  Principal:
                    Service: rds.amazonaws.com
        patches:
        # Optional: override trust policy if provided in parameters
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.iamTrustPolicyDocument
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicyDocument
          transforms:
          - type: String
            string:
              type: JSON
              json:
                op: replace
                path: /
        # Connection & status
        - type: PatchAsConnectionDetail
          fromFieldPath: status.arn
          toFieldPath: iamRoleArn
        - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: status.arn
          toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn

      # 5. IAM Role Policy (Least Privilege)
      - name: iam-role-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          metadata: {}
          spec:
            forProvider:
              policyDocument:
                Version: "2012-10-17"
                Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource: "*"
        patches:
        # Bind to role
        - type: SelectComposite
          matchResources:
          - iam-role
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleName
        # Scope S3 resources to the provisioned bucket (no wildcards in prod)
        - type: SelectComposite
          matchResources:
          - s3-bucket
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policyDocument
          transforms:
          - type: String
            string:
              type: JSON
              json:
                op: replace
                path: /Statement/0/Resource
                value: "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"

      # 6. IAM Role Policy Attachment
      - name: iam-role-policy-attachment
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicyAttachment
          metadata: {}
          spec:
            forProvider: {}
        patches:
        - type: SelectComposite
          matchResources:
          - iam-role
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
        - type: SelectComposite
          matchResources:
          - iam-role-policy
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policyName
```

### Key Implementation Details

| Acceptance Criteria | How It's Met |
|---------------------|--------------|
| **Bucket versioning + encryption** | `versioning.status: Enabled` & `sseAlgorithm: AES256` baked into base |
| **No public access** | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` resource enforces all 4 blocks |
| **RDS deletion protection + backups** | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod: 7` in base |
| **RDS not publicly accessible** | `publiclyAccessible: false` in base |
| **Secrets never in Git** | `PatchAsConnectionDetail` writes RDS connection strings & IAM ARN to Kubernetes
